newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia credit unions merger cleared by members.
newsitem.headline: Australia credit unions merger cleared by members.

text.p: Queensland credit unions Credit Union Australia (CUA) Ltd and CPS Credit Society Ltd said on Friday their members had voted overwhelmingly to merge the two institutions to create Australia's second largest credit union.
The new entity, which will have assets of about A$650 million, will be known as Credit Union Australia Ltd (CUA).
In a statement, CUA's chief executive Graham Olrich said the amalgamation would strengthen the new entity's ability to compete with the banking sector.
